dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Ah, when do you think this war will end, eh...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: I am willing to do anything to keep my sister safe, but I don't want to fight this war.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your sister...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Yeah, I have a very cute little sister. She is currently back home on Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: My sister is still young, but she is very clever and understanding. As her big brother, I hope that she can remain innocent and pure. I really don't want her to find out about the ugly side of this world.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Didn't someone once say that there is no winner in a war? As long as there is conflict, people will get hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Therefore, I have to stay here and fight for the sake of my sister's safety even though I hate fighting. I shall not let the Shogunate's army set foot upon my homeland.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope my little sister at home is doing well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your homeland...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: My family spent many generations in Bourou Village on Watatsumi Island. It's a small village with beautiful scenery, and people lead peaceful lives there.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: When I was small, I would often listen to the sound of waterfalls nearby. I would stay there for the whole day...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for this war, I probably would never have left my home and would have just spent a quiet, peaceful life there instead...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Sangonomiya and the Shogunate have signed their ceasefire agreement. Guess we shouldn't expect a resumption of the conflict any time soon.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: I just hope I can return to see my sister soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your sister...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: Yeah, I have a very cute little sister. She is currently back home on Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: My sister is still young, but she is very clever and understanding. As her big brother, I hope that she can remain innocent and pure even as she grows up healthy and strong.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: I will do my best to keep the peace for her sake as well. The Shogun's Army will not set foot on our homeland — not if I have anything to say about that!
